installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
# PotenFYR Studios - Multi-Database Universal Installer
if [ -d /mnt/server ]; then
    cd /mnt/server || exit 1
elif [ -d /home/container ]; then
    cd /home/container || exit 1
else
    cd "$(pwd)" || exit 1
fi
SERVER_DIR="$(pwd)"

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/data" "${SERVER_DIR}/config" "${SERVER_DIR}/logs" "${SERVER_DIR}/bin"

# A .git directory means this volume is a SOURCE CHECKOUT, not a panel server
# volume - never self-clean there (protects developer clones AND any repo the
# user synced into the workspace that kept its history).
if [ ! -d "${SERVER_DIR}/.git" ]; then
# Remove obsolete scripts copied by previous egg versions - ONLY when they are
# PotenFYR-signed runtime files. User files (e.g. synced from GIT_REPO_URL)
# with the same names are never touched, so a panel Reinstall cannot wipe them.
for _f in "${SERVER_DIR}/run.sh" "${SERVER_DIR}/entrypoint.sh"; do
    if [ -f "${_f}" ] && grep -q "PotenFYR Studios" "${_f}" 2>/dev/null; then
        rm -f "${_f}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
done
unset _f
if [ -d "${SERVER_DIR}/scripts" ]; then
    _managed=1
    for _sf in "${SERVER_DIR}/scripts"/* "${SERVER_DIR}/scripts"/.*; do
        [ -e "${_sf}" ] || continue
        case "${_sf}" in
            */.|*/..) continue ;;
            *.sh) grep -q "PotenFYR Studios" "${_sf}" 2>/dev/null || _managed=0 ;;
            *) _managed=0 ;;
        esac
    done
    if [ "${_managed}" = "1" ]; then
        rm -rf "${SERVER_DIR}/scripts" 2>/dev/null || true
    else
        echo "[install] Keeping ./scripts - it contains non-runtime (user) files."
    fi
    unset _managed _sf
fi
fi

# Extra downloads requested via the EXTRA_URLS startup variable (install time,
# idempotent on reinstall). One entry per line, either "dest/name|url"
# (relative to the server dir) or a plain URL (stored under bin/).
if [ -n "${EXTRA_URLS:-}" ]; then
    echo "[install] Processing EXTRA_URLS..."
    printf '%s\n' "${EXTRA_URLS}" | tr '\r' '\n' | while IFS= read -r _line; do
        _line=$(printf '%s' "${_line}" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
        [ -n "${_line}" ] || continue
        case "${_line}" in \#*) continue ;; esac
        case "${_line}" in
            *\|*) _url="${_line#*|}"; _dest="${_line%%|*}" ;;
            *)    _url="${_line}"; _dest="bin/$(basename "${_line}")" ;;
        esac
        case "${_url}" in
            http://*|https://*) : ;;
            *) echo "[install] WARN: skipping non-http entry: $(printf '%s' "${_url}" | cut -c1-24)..."; continue ;;
        esac
        if [ -z "${_dest}" ] || [ "${_dest}" = "${_url}" ]; then
            echo "[install] WARN: no destination for entry, skipping"; continue
        fi
        _out="${SERVER_DIR}/${_dest}"
        _outdir=$(dirname "${_out}")
        mkdir -p "${_outdir}" 2>/dev/null || true
        if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            curl -fsSL --retry 3 --max-time 300 -o "${_out}" "${_url}" \
                && echo "[install] downloaded ${_dest}" \
                || echo "[install] WARN: download failed: ${_dest}"
        elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            wget -qO "${_out}" "${_url}" \
                && echo "[install] downloaded ${_dest}" \
                || echo "[install] WARN: download failed: ${_dest}"
        else
            echo "[install] WARN: neither curl nor wget available for EXTRA_URLS"
        fi
    done
fi

chown -R 988:988 "${SERVER_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true
chmod -R 755 "${SERVER_DIR}/data" "${SERVER_DIR}/config" "${SERVER_DIR}/logs" "${SERVER_DIR}/bin" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "[install] Server environment prepared successfully."

variables.name: Database Type
variables.description:
Engine to run (installed isolated inside the container on demand).
SQL: mariadb, mysql, postgresql, cockroachdb, yugabytedb, tidb, dolt
NoSQL: mongodb (mongo), ferretdb, arangodb, orientdb, ravendb, cassandra, aerospike, rethinkdb
In-Memory/KV: redis, valkey, keydb, dragonfly, memcached, etcd, nats, immudb, consul
Vector/Search: meilisearch, typesense, qdrant, elasticsearch, opensearch, solr, manticoresearch, milvus, weaviate, quickwit
Time-Series/Storage: influxdb, clickhouse, victoriametrics, prometheus, questdb, seaweedfs, garage, minio, pocketbase, loki, sqlite
Graph/Ledger/Events: neo4j, dgraph, surrealdb, kafka | Misc: sqld, custom
Versions: latest, stable, beta, alpha, nightly, snapshot, a major (18), a series (11.4),
an exact version (8.0.45) or a direct https URL. Invalid/nonexistent pins are refused
with a 'Did you mean ...?' list of the closest published versions.

variables.name: Database Version
variables.description: Version to run. 'latest' auto-resolves upstream newest. Series like 18 or 11.4 resolve to the latest patch automatically; full versions (8.0.45) are used as-is. Switching majors never deletes old data - a fresh data/<engine>/<version> instance is created and the old one is preserved.

variables.name: Strict Version Enforcement
variables.description: 1 = refuse to start if the exact requested version cannot be provided (no silent downgrades). 0 = warn and fall back to best available binary.

variables.name: Database Name
variables.description: The default database/schema to create on startup.

variables.name: Database Usernames
variables.description: Comma-separated database users to create/manage (no limit; e.g. 'alice,bob,carol'). Each user owns their private database '<user>_db' with full rights and also gets access to the shared database below. Adding or removing names applies on the next start: new users are created, removed users are deleted with their credentials (their database is preserved). Invalid/reserved names are skipped with a warning. Leave empty for the legacy single user 'dbuser'.

variables.name: Database User Passwords
variables.description: Comma-separated passwords positionally matched to Database Usernames (e.g. 'S3cretA,S3cretB'). An empty slot generates a fresh random password for that user. Passwords apply exactly once, at user creation: existing users' credentials are never changed by restarts or edits. Generated/stored passwords are recorded in .env and .db-users/credentials (mode 600).

variables.name: Root / Admin / Master Password
variables.description: Password for Root, Superuser, Admin, or Master Key. Leave EMPTY (or 'auto') to auto-generate an ultra-strong random secret. If you set a password, it is used for the root account and rotates an existing root credential on the next start.

variables.name: Auto Generate Strong Secrets
variables.description: 1 = Automatically generate cryptographically secure 32-character random passwords if fields are empty or 'auto', and update startup environment variables.

variables.name: Save Credentials to .env
variables.description: 1 = Persist database connection parameters and credentials into /home/container/.env (mode 600). Set to 0 to keep credentials strictly in process startup variables.

variables.name: Dynamic Performance Auto-Tuning
variables.description: 1 = Automatically calculate buffer pools, cache sizes, memory limits, and I/O threads based on allocated container RAM and CPU cores.

variables.name: Production Security Hardening
variables.description: 1 = Enforce SCRAM-SHA-256 encryption, drop insecure default database accounts, restrict permissions, and disable dangerous debug commands.

variables.name: Extra Daemon Arguments
variables.description: Additional custom CLI flags passed directly to the database daemon on startup.

variables.name: Extra Download URLs
variables.description: Extra files to download at install time (one per line, e.g. 'dest/name|url' or plain URL).

variables.name: Custom Startup Command
variables.description: Command to run when DATABASE_TYPE=custom.

variables.name: Smart Companion & Extra Runtimes
variables.description: Comma-separated companion tools to dynamically inject on-demand into .runtimes/ (e.g. python, uv, nodejs, bun, litestream, rclone, aws, psql, mongosh).

variables.name: Archive On Version Switch
variables.description: 1 = when switching engine versions/upgrading, snapshot the previous data directory into ./archive/<engine>/ (compressed copy; originals are never deleted) so rollback is always possible. Credentials in .env are retained across switches either way. 0 = skip archiving.

variables.name: Redis Overcommit Memory
variables.description: 1 = attempt vm.overcommit_memory=1 on the host for safe Redis fork()/background saves (requires root; otherwise prints one guidance line). Set 0 to skip entirely.

variables.name: Host Somaxconn
variables.description: Attempt net.core.somaxconn on the host for connection-heavy engines (0 = skip). Needs root; unprivileged runs print guidance only.

variables.name: Disable Transparent Huge Pages
variables.description: 1 = attempt THP=madvise on the host (reduces latency spikes for Redis/MongoDB). Needs root; unprivileged runs are silent no-ops.

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: https GitHub repository to sync into the server workspace on startup (e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo or owner/repo). Leave empty to disable. On the first boot the repo is cloned; on later boots new commits are detected, the previous code is archived into ./archive/git-sync/ and only repo-managed files are replaced. Database data (data/), credentials (.env), bin/, logs/, config/ are never touched.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to track in the Git repository (empty = the repo's default branch).

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Admin-only access token for PRIVATE repositories (classic PAT or fine-grained, read-only is enough). Never logged, never written to disk. Leave empty for public repos.

variables.name: Git Archive On Update
variables.description: 1 = when new commits are detected, snapshot the previous synced code into ./archive/git-sync/ before updating (rollback always possible). 0 = replace without archiving.

variables.name: Egg Update URL
variables.description: Check EGG_UPDATE_URL on startup and self-update the launcher when the upstream egg changed (raw GitHub egg JSON or run.sh URL).

variables.name: Auto Update Egg
variables.description: 1 = check EGG_UPDATE_URL on startup and self-update the launcher when the upstream egg changed. 0 = disable the check entirely.

variables.name: Panel Stop Watcher
variables.description: Watch console stdin for stop commands ('stop', '^C', 'exit', ...) delivered as text by TTY daemons (Feather Panel and other Wings-family stops). auto = on for all consoles; 0 = disable (keep stdin for the database); 1 = force on.

variables.name: Console Theme
variables.description: Console output style. 'db' = agent theme (</> database-eggs prefixes); 'classic' = the previous [PotenFYR] bracket style.

variables.name: Banner Gradient
variables.description: Boot banner color gradient: auto (random per boot), citrus, aurora, sunset, ocean, candy, spectrum, or none (flat).
